policy.source_comparability_warning: METAR and DMI instruments/reporting differ; station and source groups reported separately

sampling_protocol: One prior-calendar-day 00Z issue, fixed 6/12/18/24 hour leads; each 16:31 UTC. All failed leads recorded in availability receipt.
model_policy: Exact same frozen v2 corrections; original HARMONIE control; cannot fit on any dense holdout outcomes.
sampling_unit: originating forecast issue UTC date, NOT all valid dates or station-variable records
uncertainty: cluster bootstrap by model issue day, 2000 draws, fixed seed
readiness_gate: at least 30 different forecast issue dates and at least 3 stations within the reported group
